items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 5:1
items.html: The light of Atzilut means the light of Hochma, for KHB ZON are prepared by AK and ABYA. And although there are also Bina and ZON in Atzilut in which there is no light of Hochma, nevertheless there is no separating screen upon the light of Hochma, and they are fit to ascend and clothe the Hochma. But in the world of Beriah there is a separating screen upon the light of Hochma, and they have only the level of SAG in the discernment of covered Hassadim, separated from the light of Hochma. Therefore they are called a light of offshoot and a new creation, because the Hassadim in them were separated from Hochma, which was not so in Atzilut. And it is discerned that when the light of Atzilut descends to Beriah, it descends through the screen that is between Atzilut and Beriah, and this screen separates its Hochma and leaves it in Atzilut, and passes through only the Hassadim separated from Hochma. (Items 34, 36).
